text:
sam: Quick check — noticed the onboarding quickstart still shows a plaintext token in the example. I opened a docs PR to switch the snippet to env-var + SDK v3 usage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
maria: link saved — thanks for flagging. Is it just the JS snippet?
sam: main JS snippet + Dockerfile example and the Makefile dev command. Docs CI flagged it as a lint/security fail.
alex: I can take the Dockerfile + Makefile changes. Will also remove the token literal and reference REDWOOD_API_KEY. :thumbsup:
li: suggested JS pattern to include in the PR: 
```js
// use env var, avoid inlining secrets
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const reply = await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] });
console.log(reply.output);
```
ossie: also update the quickstart note about rotating tokens and add a short link to the KMS guide. People often miss that.
sam: @alex can you also add a one-liner about rotation + link to ops docs? Tomorrow morning's onboarding uses this guide so it'd be great to have it in by then.
alex: yep. I'll add the rotation note and update the PR today. ETA ~30m.
devex-bot: docs-ci status: failed for PR #412 — snippet-token-lint (security)
maria: who can review once alex pushes? I can triage but might need another pair of eyes on wording.
li: happy to review after lunch, can check sample output and copy.
alex: pushed changes: removed inline token, updated Dockerfile to use ARG/ENV and added --env-file example, added rotation note with link to https://internal.redwood/kms-rotation-guide
maria: running a local build now to sanity-check includes and code fencing.
devex-bot: docs-ci status: success for PR #412 :shipit:
sam: amazing — thanks everyone. Closing the loop before tomorrow's session. :tada:
